news.title: Greenfield Academy posts a 100% pass rate in KCSE 2024
news.excerpt: All 148 candidates qualified for university placement, with 41 learners scoring A or A minus and a mean grade of B plus for the school.
news.body: Our 2024 candidate class delivered the strongest results in the history of the school. Every one of the 148 candidates attained the university entry grade, 41 learners scored A or A minus, and the school mean rose to B plus. The Principal thanked teachers, parents and the candidates themselves for a year of disciplined, joyful work.

news.title: Robotics club wins the Nairobi County science and engineering fair
news.excerpt: A team of four Grade 11 learners took first place with a solar powered water quality sensor built in the Greenfield innovation lab.
news.body: Our robotics club entered the county science and engineering fair with a low cost water quality sensor powered entirely by a small solar panel. The judges praised the accuracy of the prototype and its potential for rural boreholes. The team now proceeds to the national fair in April.

news.title: New resource centre and reading wing opens to learners
news.excerpt: The two storey resource centre adds 12,000 titles, 40 study carrels and a dedicated digital research lab for senior school learners.
news.body: After eighteen months of construction, the Greenfield resource centre is open. The ground floor holds the junior library and story corner, while the upper floor is reserved for senior school private study and digital research. The project was funded by the school and the Greenfield Parents Association.

news.title: Choir and brass band head to the national music festival
news.excerpt: Both ensembles took first place at the regional eliminations and will represent Nairobi at the Kenya Music Festival in Nakuru.
news.body: The Greenfield choir and the brass band swept their categories at the regional eliminations held in Nairobi. Mr. Brian Kiprotich, Head of Arts and Music, credited an early start to the season and the new practice rooms in the arts block.
